items.name: M1_bed_groove
items.text: Instrumental ancient Egyptian cinematic folk music, 110 BPM, Hijaz maqam on D (D, E-flat, F-sharp, G, A, B-flat, C) over a D drone. Opens with a solo ney flute over a low drone for about 6 seconds, then a darbuka plays the maqsum rhythm with riq and finger cymbals, an oud plucks a catchy motif and a qanun answers with fast runs, frame drum hits on each bar; it builds to a fuller, majestic finish with low strings. Playful, mysterious, majestic. Clean, punchy mix. No vocals.

items.name: M2_bed_underworld
items.text: Instrumental mystical ancient Egyptian underworld music for a judgement scene, slow 70 BPM, Hijaz maqam on D, deep drone and soft low strings, a breathy ney flute melody, slow frame drum pulses like a heartbeat, sistrum shimmers, large temple reverb. Sacred, tense, awe. No vocals.

items.name: S01_heartbeat
items.text: slow deep human heartbeat, close and intimate, in a quiet stone chamber

items.name: S02_scale_settle

items.name: S03_croc_snap

items.name: S04_beast_growl

items.name: S05_wings

items.name: S06_sistrum

items.name: S07_gong

items.name: S08_stone_door

items.name: S09_sand_wind

items.name: S10_magic_reveal

items.name: S11_frame_drum

items.name: S12_torch
